message.content:
The median (i.e., the middle value) of all residential home sales in California is roughly **$800 000–$850 000** as of the most recent data (2024‑early).  
If you’re looking for the arithmetic mean (average) rather than the median, it tends to be a bit higher—typically in the **$900 000–$1 000 000** range—because a handful of very expensive properties pull the mean up.  

These figures come from the latest Zillow Home Value Index and the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey, both of which track California’s housing market on a monthly basis.
